content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Recreating Records ## slug: payments-dataload-historical-transactions-recreating-records ## seoTitle: Recreating Records ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Records that exist in Stripe but not in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} can be recreated in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} from the Stripe IDs. Here's an example of recreating a charge so the refund can be conducted within {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. 1. Log into the Stripe dashboard to see the relevant IDs. * Gather the following IDs: * Card ID * Customer ID * Transaction ID 2. Create a new Transaction in Salesforce. 1. Go to Setup > Custom Settings > Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings. 2. Click **Manage** and disable relevant triggers to manipulate records. 3. Fill in the following fields: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} = Stripe Dashboard Charge amount * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Captured" * Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} lookup to the correct {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} that matches the Card ID from Step 1. 3. Click **Refund** in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.
